clips.title: The story
paras: In Thelsamar, Vidra Hearthstove keeps the town fed with blood sausages, a favorite across Loch Modan. She needs fresh ingredients from the valley to make them.

Hungry children and miners returning from the Ironband Excavation fill Thelsamar's tavern. Vidra Hearthstove tends the stove and makes the blood sausages known across Loch Modan. The recipe draws on wildlife from the rugged mountain pass.

Vidra's recipe uses boar intestines for casings and bear meat for the filling. Spider ichor gives the sausages a sharp, pungent bite. Gathering the entrails and venomous fluid takes a steady stomach, but travelers soon come to appreciate the regional favorite.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There's never a shortage of empty bellies here in Thelsamar, kids running in and out, workers from the excavation coming in after a hard day's work. We're famous for our blood sausages, I don't suppose you've ever tried them?
No? Well, around here you've got to work for your meals, and don't think just because you're a fancy adventurer, you'll be any exception.
I'll need bear meat, boar intestines for the casings, and spider ichor for spice. You get me some of those, and leave the cooking to Vidra!

clips.title: Progress
paras: I'm all ready to start cooking, do you have the ingredients for me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Trust me, it seems a lot harder than it looks, but...
Oh, I've never known someone to take much interest in the making of sausages, but I'll give you the recipe just in case. Here you go, mind you eat them fresh!
